name: Sheena Rose

name: Radcliffe Roye

name: Oneika Russell
note: Birth year from single source (Residency Unlimited); info possibly dated (~2018). Edna Manley College lecturer per some sources; PhD Kyoto Seika Univ.; Dak'Art 2018.

name: Beatriz Santiago Muñoz

works.title: Black Beach / Horse / Camp / The Dead / Forces

note: Artes Mundi Prize 2021; Whitney Biennial 2017; solo 'A Universe of Fragile Mirrors' PAMM 2016-17; co-founded Beta-Local.

name: Heino Schmid
note: Born Nassau, German heritage; residence not stated in results (Bahamas-based per context; academic at University of The Bahamas per one bio). Founding member POPOPStudios; documenta 15 with Alice Yard.

name: Esterio Segura Mora

works.title: Goodbye My Love (sculpture/installation, Tampa International Airport)

note: Born Santiago de Cuba, 22 Aug 1970. Residence 'Cuba' is from most sources describing him as Cuba-based; not confirmed current. MOLAA solo 2014-15; has taught at USF Tampa.

name: Shuck One
note: Birth year 1970 per Artsper (another listing says 1972). Moved to Paris at 14; co-founder of DCM and Basalt crews.

name: Arthur Simms

works.title: A Totem for the High Line

note: Born Kingston/St Andrew; emigrated to Brooklyn 1969; represented Jamaica at 2001 Venice Biennale; survey at Karma 2023 (NYT 17 Mar 2023); Professor at CUNY LaGuardia CC.

name: Kelly Sinnapah Mary
note: Indo-Caribbean heritage. Solo 'The Book of Violette' at James Cohan NY 2025; Aicon NY 2023-24; survey at The Aldrich Feb-Jun 2027 and Americas Society Apr-Jul 2027.

name: Roberta Stoddart
residence: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
note: Sleepwalkers dated 2009-2017; acquired by Wereldmuseum Rotterdam for 'Live the Surreal' (17 Sep 2026 - 29 Aug 2027). Moved to Trinidad 1999; Kingston birthplace from single listing (Casa d'Aros).

name: Tavares Strachan
note: MacArthur Fellow 2022; survey 'The Day Tomorrow Began' (LACMA/Columbus Museum of Art) travels to Columbus 2026-27.

name: Philippe Thomarel
note: Residence not stated. Painter (bridges, dogs, portraits). Exhibitions: 'LXXVIII: Quand le ciel bas et lourd' (Transilvania Univ. Brasov, Oct 2023, after 1-month residency); 'Les territoires radiographiques' (Fondation Clément).

name: Phillip Thomas
note: Painter, born Kingston; BFA Edna Manley College 2003, MFA New York Academy of Art; Bronze Musgrave Medal 2014. Older bio says lived in New York; Kingston is the more recent claim. Not Cutty Ranks (Philip Thomas).

name: Jasmine Thomas-Girvan
residence: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
note: Jamaican-born; in Trinidad since 2000 (Maraval/Port of Spain). Shows: 'Bathed in Sacred Fire' Kunstinstituut Melly 2021; 'Affinities' with Chris Ofili, David Zwirner London 2019; 'Window on Memory' Brown Univ. 2023.

name: Thierry Tian-Sio-Po
note: Single source says born 1964 in Guyana(e) and still lives/works there; catalogue lists him as Guyane (French Guiana). Not confirmed by multiple sources. AICA-SC has a 2013 'Conversation with Thierry Tian Sio Po'.
